requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D wuxia game VFX source sprite sheet, original visual expansion for Luohan Fumo inner cultivation from Xia Ke Xing. Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 image with exactly FOUR equally sized 768x512 cells in a 2 columns by 2 rows arrangement, read left to right then top to bottom. Background must be perfectly plain pure white #FFFFFF. No visible grid, no labels, no writing, no border, no paper texture, no shadows, no hands, no characters, no props. Each cell contains only ONE isolated golden ink-wash qi effect, center at the same relative pixel position (384,256); all mist and flecks stay at least 48 pixels away from EVERY cell boundary. Harmonious gold ochre and amber with dark bronze strokes, delicately translucent watercolor wisps and broken dry-brush edges, substantial colored pigment so white-keying preserves it. All light cores must be yellow-ochre, NEVER white, cream or near-white solid paint. No neon, no fire, no realistic smoke, no metal objects, no 3D render. Four animation keyframes are weak formation, full clear peak, gentle loosening, thin residual form; preserve center and main silhouette, do not change viewpoint or position. Subject: a long horizontally oval, flowing recirculating breath of golden qi. An open double-loop ribbon, two connected curling streams that merge into a softly rounded front on the RIGHT, with a visible broad misty root near local (115,256) on the LEFT. Main peak silhouette stays between local x=90..676 and y=125..387. This is a quiet internal circulating current that can also be stretched toward the right as a cohesive emitted force. Hollow white breathing room between brush ribbons, amber root visibly connected to all loops. No pointed blade, no arrow, no ray, no symbolic glyphs. Distinct but coherent four temporal states.
